title: 第235章  虎兔藏身！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈冰心脸色一变。

“宋青山！”

她立刻按住他心口，将清神针刺入膻中穴。

宋青山身体没有倒。

但眉心守井印剧烈闪烁，金光明灭不定。

黑先生轻声道：“它选中你了。”

沈冰心眼中寒意大盛。

“闭嘴。”

她又一针飞出，直刺黑先生咽喉。

黑先生偏头避过。

银针擦过面具边缘，留下一道细细裂痕。

无纹黑面具上，终于出现了一道白痕。

黑先生抬手摸了摸面具。

“有意思。”

沈冰心没有退。

她知道，此刻只要退一步，宋青山就可能被井心拖走。

神识黑河里。

宋青山被暗红眼睛锁住。

那股力量太强。

强到他仿佛正在被拖向石门。

一旦神识被拖入井心，肉身即便还在，也会变成空壳。

就在这时，一道清亮龙吟在他心神深处响起。

龙妹妹的声音带着少见的怒意。

“看什么看！”

“没见过龙吗？”

下一瞬，一道淡金龙影从宋青山神识后方冲出。

龙影不大，却极其灵动。

它盘绕在金色小剑周围，硬生生咬断了几只抓来的黑手。

暗红眼睛的意念微微一滞。

显然，它没想到宋青山神识里还藏着这玩意儿。

宋青山心中一松。

“来得及时。”

龙妹妹哼了一声。

“你再晚一点，我就要考虑给你收尸了。”

“神识哪来的尸？”

“那就收空壳。”

宋青山没有再分心。

有龙影护住神识，他终于能继续向前。

黑线尽头，弃井印与井心的连接节点已经出现。

那是一枚嵌在黑河底部的黑色钉子。

钉子一端连着黑先生胸口弃井印。

另一端扎入井心石门缝隙。

只要斩断这枚钉，黑先生就无法继续借井心之力。

但钉子周围，盘着一道暗红影子。

那不是完整灾厄。

只是门后意志探出的一根触须。

龙妹妹声音沉下。

“这东西不能让它碰到你。”

宋青山道：“你挡它一息。”

“一息？”

“够了。”

龙妹妹没有再废话。

淡金龙影猛地扑向暗红触须。

触须瞬间缠来，龙影被压得光芒一暗。

也就在这一息内，宋青山神识金剑燃起至阳之光。

“断。”

黑钉裂开。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Shen Bingxin's expression changed.

"Song Qingshan!"

She immediately pressed his heart and inserted the Qingshen needle into the Tanzhong point.

Song Qingshan's body did not collapse.

But the well seal between the eyebrows flickered violently, and the golden light flickered uncertainly.

Mr. Black said softly: "It has chosen you."

Shen Bingxin's eyes were filled with coldness.

"Shut up."

Another needle flew out and stabbed directly into Mr. Black's throat.

Mr. Black turned his head to avoid it.

The silver needle grazed the edge of the mask, leaving a thin crack.

A white mark finally appeared on the streakless black mask.

Mr. Black raised his hand and touched the mask.

"Interesting."

Shen Bingxin did not retreat.

She knew that as long as she took a step back at this moment, Song Qingshan might be dragged away by the center of the well.

Divine consciousness in the black river.

Song Qingshan was locked with dark red eyes.

That power is too strong.

It was so strong that he seemed to be being dragged towards the stone door.

Once the consciousness is dragged into the center of the well, even if the physical body is still there, it will become an empty shell.

At this moment, a clear dragon roar sounded deep in his mind.

Sister Long's voice was filled with rare anger.

"What are you looking at!"

"Have you never seen a dragon?"

The next moment, a pale golden dragon shadow rushed out from behind Song Qingshan's consciousness.

The dragon shadow is not big, but it is extremely agile.

It coiled around the golden sword and bit off several of the black hands it had grabbed.

The thoughts with dark red eyes were slightly stagnant.

Obviously, it didn't expect that Song Qingshan still had this thing hidden in his consciousness.

Song Qingshan felt relieved.

"It came just in time."

Sister Long snorted.

"If you wait any longer, I will consider collecting your body."

"Where did the corpse come from?"

"Then collect the empty shells."

Song Qingshan was no longer distracted.

With the dragon shadow protecting his consciousness, he was finally able to move forward.

At the end of the black line, the connection node between the abandoned well mark and the well center has appeared.

It was a black nail embedded in the bottom of the Black River.

One end of the nail is connected to the abandoned well mark on Mr. Black's chest.

The other end was inserted into the gap of the stone door in the center of the well.

As long as this nail is cut off, Mr. Hei will no longer be able to borrow the power of the well.

But around the nail, there was a dark red shadow.

That's not a complete disaster.

Just a tentacle of the will behind the door.

Sister Long's voice deepened.

"You can't let this thing touch you."

Song Qingshan said: "You block it for a breath."

"One breath?"

"That's enough."

Sister Long didn't talk nonsense anymore.

The light golden dragon shadow pounced towards the dark red tentacles.

The tentacles wrapped around him instantly, and the dragon shadow was suppressed until its light dimmed.

In this breath, Song Qingshan's golden sword of divine consciousness ignited with the light of the sun.

"Break."

The black nails cracked.
